quarterly_data.quarter: Alamar Biosciences press release: Alamar Biosciences Expands Global Partnership with (08-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The release on the expanded Alzheimer's Disease Data Initiative and Gates Ventures partnership adds to the call: the NULISAseq Neuro 220 panel measures approximately 220 neurological biomarker targets from small volumes of plasma or cerebrospinal fluid and includes eMTBR-Tau alongside established markers like p-Tau217, which the company says enables blood-based capture of both hallmark Alzheimer's pathologies for the first time; the approximately 21,000-sample national-scale proteomics initiative was launched with leading research universities in mid-July; the collaboration is named NULISA NeuroData Commons; and the combined dataset, which the company expects to represent the largest study of neurodegenerative disease, will be integrated with clinical and longitudinal outcome data.
quarterly_data.figure: approximately 220 biomarker targets per panel; approximately 21,000 samples in the national-scale initiative
